Check for split trigger: if the first candidate has accumulated\n227\t        //    enough consecutive failures, dispatch a SPLIT instruction instead\n228\t        //    of returning the bead for normal processing.\n229\t        if self.split_after_failures > 0 {\n230\t            if let Some(first_candidate) = candidates.first() {\n231\t                let failure_count = Self::extract_failure_count(first_candidate);\n232\t                tracing::debug!(\n233\t                    bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n234\t                    failure_count = failure_count,\n235\t                    threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n236\t                    split_triggered = failure_count >= self.split_after_failures,\n237\t                    \"Checking split trigger for first candidate\"\n238\t                );\n239\t\n240\t                if failure_count >= self.split_after_failures {\n241\t                    tracing::info!(\n242\t                        bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n243\t                        failure_count = failure_count,\n244\t                        threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n245\t                        \"Split threshold reached, returning Split instruction\"\n246\t                    );\n247\t                    return StrandResult::Split(Box::new(first_candidate.clone()), failure_count);\n248\t                }\n249\t            }\n250\t        } else {\n251\t            tracing::debug!(\"Split trigger disabled (threshold = 0)\");\n252\t        }\n253\t\n254\t        // 6. Return result.\n255\t        if candidates.is_empty() {\n256\t            tracing::debug!(\"No candidates remaining after filtering, returning NoWork\");\n257\t            StrandResult::NoWork\n258\t        } else {\n259\t            let candidate_ids: Vec<&str> = candidates.iter()\n260\t                .map(|b| b.id.as_ref())\n261\t                .collect();\n262\t            tracing::info!(\n263\t                count = candidates.len(),\n264\t                candidates = ?candidate_ids,\n265\t                \"Returning {} candidates for processing\",\n266\t                candidates.len()\n267\t            );\n268\t            StrandResult::BeadFound(candidates)\n269\t        }\n270\t    }\n271\t}\n272\t\n273\t// ─── Unit tests Pluck strand: primary bead selection from the assigned workspace.\n//!\n//! Pluck handles >90% of all bead processing. It queries the bead store for\n//! unassigned, ready beads, filters by excluded labels, and sorts them in\n//! deterministic priority order: `(priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)`.\n//!\n//! Given the same queue state, every worker computes the same candidate list.\n\nuse crate::bead_store::{BeadStore, Filters};\nuse crate::types::{Bead, StrandError, StrandResult};\n\n/// Default labels excluded from Pluck selection when not configured.\nconst DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS: &[&str] = &[\"deferred\", \"human\", \"blocked\"];\n\n/// The Pluck strand — primary work selection.\npub struct PluckStrand {\n    /// Labels to exclude from candidate selection.\n    exclude_labels: Vec<String>,\n    /// Auto-split beads after this many consecutive failures (0 = disabled).\n    split_after_failures: u32,\n}\n\nimpl PluckStrand {\n    /// Create a new PluckStrand with the given exclude labels.\n    ///\n    /// If `exclude_labels` is empty, the default set (`deferred`, `human`,\n    /// `blocked`) is used.\n    pub fn new(exclude_labels: Vec<String>) -> Self {\n        let labels = if exclude_labels.is_empty() {\n            DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| (*s).to_string())\n                .collect()\n        } else {\n            exclude_labels\n        };\n        PluckStrand {\n            exclude_labels: labels,\n            split_after_failures: 3, // default threshold\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new PluckStrand with the given exclude labels and split threshold.\n    ///\n    /// If `exclude_labels` is empty, the default set (`deferred`, `human`,\n    /// `blocked`) is used.\n    pub fn with_split_threshold(exclude_labels: Vec<String>, split_after_failures: u32) -> Self {\n        let labels = if exclude_labels.is_empty() {\n            DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_LABELS\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| (*s).to_string())\n                .collect()\n        } else {\n            exclude_labels\n        };\n        PluckStrand {\n            exclude_labels: labels,\n            split_after_failures,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Extract the failure count from a bead's labels.\n    ///\n    /// Labels follow the pattern `failure-count:N`. Returns the count if found,\n    /// or 0 if no failure-count label exists.\n    fn extract_failure_count(bead: &Bead) -> u32 {\n        bead.labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0)\n    }\n\n    /// Sort candidates in deterministic priority order.\n    ///\n    /// Sort key: `(priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)`.\n    /// The id tie-breaker ensures identical ordering across platforms.\n    fn sort_candidates(candidates: &mut [Bead]) {\n        candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n            a.priority\n                .cmp(&b.priority)\n                .then_with(|| a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| a.id.as_ref().cmp(b.id.as_ref()))\n        });\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for PluckStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"pluck\"\n    }\n\n    #[tracing::instrument(\n        name = \"strand.pluck\",\n        skip(self, store),\n        fields(\n            strand = \"pluck\",\n            exclude_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n            split_threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n        )\n    )]\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n        tracing::debug!(\n            exclude_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n            split_threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n            \"Pluck strand evaluation starting\"\n        );\n\n        // 1. Query bead store for ready, unassigned beads.\n        let filters = Filters {\n            assignee: None,\n            exclude_labels: self.exclude_labels.clone(),\n        };\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            filters = ?filters,\n            \"Querying bead store for ready candidates\"\n        );\n\n        let mut candidates = match store.ready(&filters).await {\n            Ok(beads) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    count = beads.len(),\n                    \"Bead store returned {} candidates\",\n                    beads.len()\n                );\n                beads\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::error!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"Bead store query failed\"\n                );\n                // Bead store error is semantically different from NoWork.\n                return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n            }\n        };\n\n        // 2. after_label_filter\n            );\n\n            // Log each excluded bead at DEBUG level\n            let excluded_beads: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()\n                .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)))\n                .map(|b| (b.id.as_ref(), b.labels.clone()))\n                .collect();\n            for (id, labels) in excluded_beads {\n                let excluded_reasons: Vec<_> = labels.iter()\n                    .filter(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l))\n                    .map(|l| l.as_str())\n                    .collect();\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %id,\n                    labels = ?labels,\n                    excluded_reasons = ?excluded_reasons,\n                    \"Excluded bead due to labels\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            // Re-filter since we logged them\n            candidates.retain(|b| !b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)));\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_label_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by label filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 3. These are never claimable — the claimer\n        //    will reject them every time, causing a hot loop.\n        let before_status_filter = candidates.len();\n        candidates.retain(|b| {\n            !(matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress)\n                || (b.status == crate::types::BeadStatus::Open && b.assignee.is_some()))\n        });\n        let after_status_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        if before_status_filter != after_status_filter {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                filtered_count = before_status_filter - after_status_filter,\n                remaining = after_status_filter,\n                \"Status/assignee filtering removed {} beads\",\n                before_status_filter - after_status_filter\n            );\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_status_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by status/assignee filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 4. Sort: deterministic (priority, created_at, id).\n        if !candidates.is_empty() {\n            let first = &candidates[0];\n            tracing::debug!(\n                total = candidates.len(),\n                first_bead_id = %first.id,\n                first_priority = first.priority,\n                first_created_at = %first.created_at,\n                \"Sorting {} candidates by (priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n        }\n        Self::sort_candidates(&mut candidates);\n\n        // 5. Return result.\n        if candidates.is_empty() {\n            tracing::debug!(\"No candidates remaining after filtering, returning NoWork\");\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        } else {\n            let candidate_ids: Vec<&str> = candidates.iter()\n                .map(|b| b.id.as_ref())\n                .collect();\n            tracing::info!(\n                count = candidates.len(),\n                candidates = ?candidate_ids,\n                \"Returning {} candidates for processing\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n            StrandResult::BeadFound(candidates)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use Knot strand: exhaustion alerting with three-state verification.\n//!\n//! ExhaustionDiagnosis::AllClaimed { .. } => \"all_claimed\",\n            ExhaustionDiagnosis::Invisible { .. } => \"invisible\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The Knot strand — exhaustion alerting with Perform three-state verification using a DIFFERENT code path from Pluck.\n    ///\n    /// Queries ALL beads via `list_all()` (not `ready()`) and classifies the\n    /// exhaustion reason.\n    async fn diagnose(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> Result<ExhaustionDiagnosis, StrandError> {\n        let all_beads = store.list_all().await.map_err(StrandError::StoreError)?;\n\n        if all_beads.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(ExhaustionDiagnosis::NoBeadsExist);\n        }\n\n        let total = all_beads.len();\n        let mut open_count = 0usize;\n        let mut in_progress_count = 0usize;\n        let mut claimed_by = Vec::new();\n\n        for bead in &all_beads {\n            match bead.status {\n                BeadStatus::Open => {\n                    open_count += 1;\n                }\n                BeadStatus::InProgress => {\n                    in_progress_count += 1;\n                    if let Some(ref assignee) = bead.assignee {\n                        if !claimed_by.contains(assignee) {\n                            claimed_by.push(assignee.clone());\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed | BeadStatus::Blocked => {}\n                // Non-exhaustive: treat unknown statuses as neither open nor in_progress.\n                #[allow(unreachable_patterns)]\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // If no open beads remain but some are in_progress, it's normal contention.\n        if open_count == 0 && in_progress_count > 0 {\n            return Ok(ExhaustionDiagnosis::AllClaimed {\n                in_progress_count,\n                claimed_by,\n            });\n        }\n\n        // If no open beads AND no in_progress, everything is Done/Blocked — genuinely idle.\n        if open_count == 0 && in_progress_count == 0 {\n            return Ok(ExhaustionDiagnosis::NoBeadsExist);\n        }\n\n     claimed_by,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Check whether we're within the alert cooldown window.\n    fn is_within_cooldown(&self) -> bool {\n        let guard = self.last_alert_at.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());\n        if let Some(last) = *guard {\n            let cooldown = chrono::Duration::minutes(self.config.alert_cooldown_minutes as i64);\n            Utc::now() - last < cooldown\n        } else {\n            false\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record that an alert was just created.\n    fn record_alert(&self) {\n        let mut guard = self.last_alert_at.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());\n        *guard = Some(Utc::now());\n    }\n\n    /// Increment the exhaustion counter and return the new value.\n    fn increment_exhaustion(&self) -> u64 {\n        let mut guard = self\n            .exhaustion_count\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());\n        *guard += 1;\n        *guard\n    }\n\n    /// Build the alert bead body with full diagnostics.\n    fn build_alert_body(diagnosis: &ExhaustionDiagnosis, workspace: &str) -> String {\n        match diagnosis {\n            ExhaustionDiagnosis::Invisible {\n                total,\n                open_count,\n                in_progress_count,\n                claimed_by,\n            } => {\n                let claimers                **Total beads:** {total}\\n\\\n                     **Open:** {open_count}\\n\\\n                     **In-progress:** {in_progress_count}\\n\\\n                     **Claimed by:** {claimers}\\n\\n\\\n                     Check exclude_labels, workspace path, and filter configuration.\"\n                )\n            }\n            // Alert is only created for Invisible diagnosis.\n            ExhaustionDiagnosis::NoBeadsExist | ExhaustionDiagnosis::AllClaimed { .. } => {\n                String::new()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for KnotStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"knot\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n        let cycle = self.increment_exhaustion();\n\n        // Enter the strand.knot span for the exhaustion diagnosis.\n        let knot_span = tracing::info_span!(\n            \"strand.knot\",\n            needle.strand.name = \"knot\",\n            needle.strand.result = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on diagnosis\n            needle.strand.diagnosis = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on diagnosis\n            needle.strand.exhaustion_count = cycle,\n        );\n        let _knot_enter = knot_span.enter();\n\n        // Diagnose the exhaustion reason using a different code path from Pluck.\n        let diagnosis = match self.diagnose(store).await {\n            Ok(d) => d,\n            Err(e) => {\n                // Record error on the span\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.strand.result\", \"error\");\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", format!(\"{e}\"));\n                return StrandResult::Error(e);\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Record the diagnosis result on tracing::info!(\n            strand = \"knot\",\n            diagnosis = diagnosis.as_str(),\n            cycle,\n            \"knot strand evaluated\"\n        );\n\n        // Only create an alert for INVISIBLE diagnosis and only after threshold.\n        if let ExhaustionDiagnosis::Invisible { .. } = &diagnosis {\n            if cycle >= self.config.exhaustion_threshold &&
